title: Rust (programming language)
text: Rust was originally designed by Graydon Hoare at Mozilla Research; version 1.0 was released in 2015.

title: Python (programming language)
text: Python was created by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991.

title: Lake Tana
text: Lake Tana is the largest lake in Ethiopia and the source of the Blue Nile. Its area is about 3200 square kilometres.

title: Lake Abaya
text: Lake Abaya is the second largest lake in Ethiopia, with an area of about 1160 square kilometres.

title: Mount Kilimanjaro
text: Kilimanjaro in Tanzania is the highest mountain in Africa at 5895 metres.

title: Mount Ras Dashen
text: Ras Dashen is the highest mountain in Ethiopia at 4550 metres.

title: SWI-Prolog
text: SWI-Prolog is a free implementation of the Prolog language, started by Jan Wielemaker in 1987.
